content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Gumroad payhip

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is a self-hosted stack of tools that handle hosting, payment processing, order storage, and product delivery without relying on third-party platforms. Unlike Gumroad or Payhip, which require Stripe or PayPal, this system uses open components you control. The core idea is ownership: you deploy the infrastructure, you own the data, and you’re not subject to geographic or financial restrictions. For creators in Nigeria, this means selling digital products without waiting for global payment networks to change their policies. It’s not about bypassing rules—it’s about building on systems that don’t exclude you by design. The Edge Commerce Stack from COREMERCH is one such solution, deployed in 48 hours, with no recurring fees or platform lock-in.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The stack consists of four layers: hosting, backend logic, order storage, and payment processing. For hosting, Cloudflare Pages serves your storefront for free, with global CDN distribution. Backend logic is handled by Cloudflare Workers, which processes orders and triggers file delivery. Orders are stored in Supabase, a free PostgreSQL database with real-time capabilities. Payments are processed via NOWPayments, which accepts 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee and no KYC requirements. When a buyer pays, NOWPayments verifies the transaction on-chain and triggers a webhook to deliver the product via Cloudflare R2. The entire system is stateless: no buyer data is stored permanently, and you retain full ownership of your infrastructure. This design ensures low fees, instant delivery, and zero geographic restrictions.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This system is built for digital creators in regions where conventional payment gateways are unavailable or unreliable. If you sell ebooks, courses, templates, or software in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, or similar markets, this infrastructure solves three problems: payment collection, product delivery, and data ownership. It’s not a temporary fix—it’s a permanent shift to owning your commerce stack. Unlike platforms that rent you access, this model gives you lifetime control. You’re not dependent on Stripe’s or PayPal’s country policies, and you’re not subject to their fees or shutdown risks. It’s designed for creators who prioritize sovereignty over convenience, and who understand that infrastructure ownership is the only way to guarantee long-term access to global markets.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure gives you permanent control over your digital sales.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Each component in the stack is chosen for its cost, reliability, and independence from geographic restrictions. Cloudflare Pages and Workers are free and globally distributed, ensuring fast load times and low latency. Supabase provides a free, scalable database with built-in authentication and real-time updates. NOWPayments handles crypto payments without requiring buyer accounts or KYC, making it accessible to anyone with a wallet. Cloudflare R2 stores and delivers your digital products at minimal cost. Together, these tools form a cohesive system that operates without relying on any single vendor. The Edge Commerce Stack integrates these components, configures them for your products, and deploys them in 48 hours. After deployment, you own and control everything—COREMERCH has no access to your infrastructure.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this infrastructure, start by mapping your product catalog and payment preferences. Decide which cryptocurrencies to accept (BSC, Solana, and TRON are recommended for low fees). Purchase the Edge Commerce Stack from COREMERCH, and provide your product details. Within 48 hours, your stack will be deployed, with up to five products loaded and end-to-end testing completed. You’ll receive full access to the codebase and documentation, allowing you to add more products or modify the system as needed. The included 30-day support ensures you’re not left to figure it out alone. This isn’t a DIY project—it’s a professional deployment of infrastructure that gives you permanent control over your commerce operations. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to get started.

Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this if I’ve never worked with code before?

Yes, the Edge Commerce Stack is deployed and configured for you. While understanding the components helps, you don’t need coding skills to use or maintain the system. Full documentation and support are included.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?

NOWPayments is a non-custodial payment processor, so funds go directly to your wallet. If their service is unavailable, you can replace it with another crypto payment gateway without losing access to your funds or infrastructure.
How do I handle refunds or chargebacks?

Crypto transactions are irreversible, so chargebacks aren’t possible. For refunds, you can manually send cryptocurrency back to the buyer’s wallet. The system doesn’t store buyer data, so privacy is maintained.
Can I scale this for more than five products?

Yes, the stack is designed to scale. After deployment, you can add more products using the provided documentation and codebase. The infrastructure is stateless, so it handles increased volume without additional costs.
What if I need to change payment networks later?
The system is modular, so you can replace NOWPayments with another crypto gateway or add support for additional networks. You retain full control over the codebase and integrations.
